description: Find Polarion operations by keyword and get their TypeScript declarations for use inside `execute`. Returns at most `limit` matches (default 8, maximum 25). Use `offset` for paging and `detail` with operation names for full descriptions.

detail.description: Operation names, e.g. ["patchWorkItem"]: returns each declaration with its full description instead of a search.

offset.description: Skip this many matches; the result names the next offset when more remain.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "trace links" or "create work item".

name: search
title: Search Polarion operations
